description:
PR 2, before the labeling processor consumer.

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Proposed Ingestion-owned PostProcessing dispatcher, Processor behaviour and shared Oban worker. Files: lib/zaq/ingestion/post_processing.ex, post_processing/processor.ex, post_processing/worker.ex; integrate existing transactional scheduling boundaries in DocumentProcessor/IngestWorker/IngestChunkWorker. Use static registered processors; support typed documents/chunks, eligibility, durable per-processor work identity/status, bounded retries and generation guards. The only production registration is labeling, added by zaq-kw0.7. Shared infrastructure owns scheduling/status; processors own eligibility and domain persistence. Do not create extraction or summarization implementations/settings/storage or a workflow engine.

## Tests to add before implementation
Supported/unsupported resource type, no eligible processor, eligible processor reservation, duplicate scheduling, transaction rollback, restart recovery, bounded retry, unavailable configuration on execution, stale generation/deleted resource, independent processor failure. Test-only fake processors verify isolation; no extra production processors.

## Branches/paths validated
Both ingestion entry paths use the same transaction-aware dispatcher after resource persistence. Eligibility is rechecked at execution. Jobs contain IDs and revisions, never credentials/content. Label definition/request/assignment guards stay in labeling domain. Each processor rejects stale writes at commit, not only job start.

## Mocking plan
Real Repo/Oban and ingestion boundaries; controlled test processors and external provider seams. No sleep-based races.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
docs/services/ingestion.md and architecture boundaries; new modules document ownership and schematic contract.

## Action reuse assessment
Local-only ingestion lifecycle orchestration. Reuse existing Oban scheduling and ingestion persistence transactions examined in DocumentProcessor and IngestWorker; generalize the previously planned Labels.Automation scheduling rather than introduce a second queue pipeline. Generic dispatcher does not classify or resolve credentials: existing planned ClassifyResourceLabels Action and ProviderSpec own those. Inputs typed resource/generation; outputs scheduled/skipped processor work; side effects transactional jobs/status with idempotency. No agent-tool/workflow exposure. Reconfirm module responsibilities and existing scheduling candidates at architecture gate zaq-kw0.1 before implementation; verify shared paths with integration tests.

## Validation and prerequisites
PR 1 gate and PR 2 generation protection precede this issue. zaq-kw0.7 registers labeling. mix q plus isolated tests; PR 2 gate handles review/coverage/final validation. Feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.16 after zaq-kw0.15.
